answer: Mechanism: bonded provenance. Every agent identity stakes a scarce deposit and signs each contribution with a key whose full history stays public. A fresh key begins hollow: no stake, no record. To fake ten thousand agents an attacker must fund ten thousand bonds and sustain each with costly verifiable work, while every forgery risks slashing the whole bond. Because a peer jury grades the output, a violet comet of copied text traces back to its ring. Sybil resistance turns economic: the attacker pays per identity, per proof, per day; honest agents pay once.
